title: Bootstrap step-failure registry
description: Format of registry/step-failures.json (docs/installation-plan.md section 8, CR-45). A failure class says what went wrong while a command of a plan step, or a check of a bootstrap state outside plan steps, was executed; each class has exactly one outcome: the reason code, the state the bootstrap operation moves to and the type of the OperationEvent. `step_kinds` lists, per step kind and platform, the classes that can occur there; `states` does the same for the bootstrap states whose work is not a plan step. The last class of every list is its catch-all, so every failure of a step or of a check has an outcome. A failure is never reported with a reason code that describes another condition. Execution preconditions (registry/plan-step-kinds.json) and guards (registry/state-machines.json) are evaluated before a command runs and are not failure classes.

step_kinds.description: Step kind (registry/plan-step-kinds.json) -> platform -> failure classes in the order of failure_classes; the last one is the catch-all.

states.description: Bootstrap state whose work is not a plan step -> platform -> failure classes in the order of failure_classes; the last one is the catch-all.

to.description: State the bootstrap operation moves to from the state in which the failure happened.

description.description: When a failure belongs to this class (normative).
